test_categorical_roundtrip: test saving and reloading ordered and unordered Categorical Series to HDF5 store
test_categorical_dataframe: test appending a DataFrame with Categorical columns to an HDF5 store in table format
test_categorical_query: test querying HDF5-stored DataFrames with Categorical columns using where clauses

test_categorical_nan_only: test reading back HDF5 files with Categorical columns containing only NaN values
